new_pins: Config/provenance are authorized fixed siblings of the six own bank directories; accepted plan supplies no pins, so mark them newly observed, never inherited-verified
gt_scope: Only identify existing frozen GT/result/metrics declarations from the pinned actual V31 stage metadata. Do not read those payloads or dataset indexes. Complete GT/NMS binding requires a later explicit metadata-source acceptance.
gt_metadata_gap: Six obj{1,2,5,8,12,17}/metrics.json and stage_summary.json are aggregates; no per-frame GT JSON is pinned in native stage.files. Existing ground_truth/per_frame_metrics/selected_detections/gt_retention CSV pins are declarations only here. The old independent audit reads dataset index and is forbidden in this inventory.
source_stability: Hash preparer, decisions, accepted plan, accepted plan preparer and selected actual V31 stage before and after; record Python executable and actual interpreter flags
